title: Anna's Morning and Day
text:
Anna gets up at seven o'clock every day. She has a shower and eats breakfast with her family. She drinks tea and eats bread with cheese.

At eight o'clock she goes to school by bus. School starts at half past eight. After school she comes home and does her homework. In the evening she watches TV with her mother.

questions.text: What time does Anna get up?
How does Anna go to school?

options: Because she wants to be ready for the day

Because her mother works at night

questions.text: What kind of daily routine does Anna most likely have?
options: A regular routine with the same times each day
A routine with no fixed times
A routine that is mostly spent alone
A routine that changes every morning

a short wash of the body under running water
school work that students do at home

paragraph_translations: Anna wstaje każdego dnia o siódmej. Bierze prysznic i je śniadanie razem z rodziną. Pije herbatę i je chleb z serem.
O ósmej jedzie do szkoły autobusem. Szkoła zaczyna się o wpół do dziewiątej. Po szkole wraca do domu i odrabia lekcje. Wieczorem ogląda telewizję z mamą.
